displayName: Harbor Freight API - Prices, Coupons, Store Stock, Reviews
description: Harbor Freight product data as structured JSON - search harborfreight.com and list clearance with national price, sale price and end date, public coupon price, Inside Track member price and the competitor compare-at price, read one product with UPC, specifications, manuals and variants, batch prices for up to 50 items, find stores near a ZIP, check in-stock, limited or out-of-stock status and aisle for up to 20 items at nearby stores, and page customer reviews. 7 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
